Mainmatter (https://mainmatter.com/rust-consulting/) | REMOTE (EU) | Rust Engineering Consultant | Full-time | 80-100k€

Mainmatter (https://mainmatter.com), the company behind EuroRust (https://eurorust.eu) is looking for an exceptional Rust engineering consultant to join our team (led by Luca Palmieri, author of Zero to Production in Rust). You'll be supporting international clients like Google, BMW and Redis in adopting Rust: reviewing their codebase, recommending and implementing improvements, and training their team on advanced Rust concepts.

- Must be located in the EU - Excellent Rust skills, ideally several years of using Rust in a production environment - Excellent engineering skills, ideally 10+ years of professional experience - Excellent English communication skills

The ideal candidate has spoken at conferences, ran workshops, written articles etc.

See the full job description and contact information here: https://mainmatter.notion.site/Rust-Engineering-Consultant-2...
